scope: PDSCH DMRS indices R1 time-base regression; not an RTL execution result

tileclk.role: selected block clock during task execution: scalar, Venus and local memories

cycle_parameterization.mechanism: ClockedObject plus cyclesToTicks/clockEdge scheduling instead of hard-coded 1000-tick intervals
cycle_parameterization.default_1ghz_result: PASS: generated Params inherit ClockedObjectParams and all R1 functional/timing artifacts remain byte-exact

scheduler_phase_normalization.mechanism: VenusDagScheduler stepEvent uses clockEdge(cycles), so scheduler-owned work is consumed on the scheduler clock edge after a tile-origin task exit
scheduler_phase_normalization.limit: This is edge normalization, not an RTL CDC, AXI-DMA, or synchronization-latency model.

delay_rebase.purpose: Preserve the old GEM5 cycle counts while changing clock frequency; these are not RTL-measured delays.

phase_checks.cpu_rule: PASS: every system.cpu event tick is divisible by 2000
phase_checks.scheduler_rule: PASS: 14 scheduler-owned trace events are divisible by 4000
phase_checks.tile_origin_exception: task_epilogue at tick 85250000 is a 500MHz tile-origin notification and is intentionally not counted as a scheduler-edge event

acceptance_boundary: The structural time base and scheduler event phase are now observable and regression-tested. RTL R1 execution/trace remains unavailable, so there is no L2/L3 or RTL functional/timing pass claim.
